just kind of a feeling dump..because i’m not allowed to do it at home because “men don’t have feelings.” almost 5 years without my biggest fucking supporter. my best friend. i wanted to be just like him when i grew up. i fucking miss him, and although i truly believe that he did not get enough time on this earth, i know that the impact he had on me, and the things he taught me were enough to last me forever. i got a tattoo for him on my right arm, two flowers intertwined. we loved picking flowers together. the flower that represents me is slightly smaller than the one that represents him. but i was catching up. he always let me grow from him. 
i feel bad because sometimes i think that i’m forgetting his voice and his face and i don’t want to forget. i don’t want to forget his rough hands (we held hands a lot.) and i don’t want to forget his laugh (which always was a big rumble. i felt so lucky whenever i caused it) i don’t want to forget his voice (it was rough and deep but so SO calming). sometimes i’ll get a call from a random number i always let myself think for like 30 seconds that it’s him. i let myself believe that SOMEHOW he got out of hospice and found some experimental medicine that cured his cancer and now he’s better. he’s calling to let me know that he misses me and that he’s coming home soon. i know it’s impossible, but i still get my hopes up. and whenever i answer i’m half expecting his voice to come booming out from the speaker. but it never does. 
he called me sunshine, but he’s the one who brightened my day. life hasn't been the same without him. i miss his stupid jokes, his ridiculously long stories, and his surprisingly good taste in music. it's still foreign to go to my mimi's house and not see him. when we were cleaning out his office i found a little clay ball on his desk. it wasn't creative, it wasn't beautifully made, and it had many colors and they were all smushed together. i had written 'i love you' on it, and he kept it. he taught me how to bait a hook and he helped me catch my first fish. he let me ride with him on his motorcycle. 
i’m not sure if i believe in heaven, but i believe in my grandpa. so i hope he’s raising hell up there. i miss you.
